clips.start_words: I work in the Empire State Building
clips.send: A widow or widower forwards this to a grieving friend, as permission to grieve hard then let it go; awe at his quiet resilience, not sadness.
clips.caption:
At a dinner table in California, Kevin Trudeau sat beside a 92-year-old lawyer who still worked part-time in the Empire State Building, the same office since the day it opened.

Kevin asked one question he instantly regretted: was his wife's death sudden? It was. She was hit by a bus while telling him she loved him.

Married since they were 22, together every day. He cried five days straight.

Then he stopped. "That's enough mourning. You have to move on. That's what she would have wanted."

He hadn't buried the grief. He had finished it.

How long are you letting a loss run your life?

#kevintrudeau #resilience #grief #mindsetshift #lettinggo #manifestation
